description: Real Catalog release 1.7.0 contents and the Markdown text of their rules, copied unchanged from the packed @aihq/catalog built from samartomar/aih-catalog 1b774e3d (contract conformance, #191). Used to check that compatibility and rendering agree for every real item; `release/materials/` holds the exact published bytes of the five items the removal journeys install: Superpowers' verification-before-completion skill and session-start hook with their notices, and Extensions' git-guard hook with its notices; and of ECC's notices and the a11y-architect and agent-evaluator agents that require them, for the shared-copy removal journey (each file matches the SHA-256 its item in release-ecc.content.json records).
